independence.static_scope: weight/checkpoint-independent target, but not architecture-independent because RF center/contour/extent define V1 support and graph
independence.temporal_scope: empirical temporal STA was not used by V1 geometry, training loss, or checkpoint selection

rf_context.causal_history: recorded Bernoulli spike events with the model's existing RGC history shift
rf_context.definition: conditional final-logit Jacobian averaged over one real validation trial per held-out natural image

time_concepts.explicit_pathway_delay: checkpoint bounded-learnable fractional pathway delay in ms
time_concepts.rgc_history_shift: strictly past recorded spike events; no current-target input
time_concepts.tau: checkpoint bounded-learnable state decay in ms
